title: Five Defining Tactical Decisions in Sunrisers Hyderabad’s IPL Story
dek: Strategy leaves fingerprints in the data. Five measurable shifts in how Sunrisers Hyderabad play, before and since 2024, show which decisions have defined them.
excerpt: From the toss to the death overs, Sunrisers Hyderabad's approach has shifted between 2013–2023 and the seasons since 2024. Five measures, each set against the rest of the league, trace the decisions behind those shifts.

sections.heading: Decisions You Can See in the Data
body: Tactical decisions are made in team rooms, but their effects show up in the numbers: what a side chooses at the toss, how hard it attacks early, how it bowls at the end.
CricField compared Sunrisers Hyderabad in 2013–2023 with the seasons since 2024, each time against the rest of the league in the same seasons.

sections.heading: Shifts Are Not Always Choices
body: Some of these shifts follow the league rather than lead it, and some follow the players available rather than a plan. The measures are set against the rest of the league to reduce the first problem, not the second.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Five Fingerprints
body: The five measures show how Sunrisers Hyderabad's approach has moved since 2024, relative to the league.
Which of them were deliberate decisions, and which were the squad changing around a plan, is a question for the people in the room.
